## 2. AI cost model (plan §8.2 — formulas first)

Prices (official, per 1M tokens, gemini-3.8-flash paid tier):
- 2026 promotional: input **$0.75** / output **$3.75** (2026 promotional, through 2026-12-31)
- standard: input **$1.50** / output **$7.50** (standard, from 2027-01-01)

```text
requests/day   R = U × ρ × r          (U users; ρ AI opt-in fraction; r requests/active-AI-user/day)
requests/month M = R × 30
cost/month     C = M × (t_in × p_in + t_out × p_out) / 1e6
per-request    c = (t_in × p_in + t_out × p_out) / 1e6
```

Per-request cost at the token assumptions (3K in / 0.5K out): **$0.004125** (2026) / **$0.008250** (2027).

## 4. T4 — optional paid-upgrade triggers (plan §10.6)

| Trigger (observable metric) | Upgrade |
|---|---|
| Sync DB > ~350 MB sustained / pause pain / backup-for-trust | Supabase Pro (from $25/mo) |
| Dynamic requests > ~70K/day sustained or CPU-limit errors (1102) on p99 | Workers Paid ($5/mo) |
| Email-sign-in demand or brand-domain need | Domain + Resend path |
| AI demand + privacy approval | Paid Gemini key (per the AI tables above) |
| >50 concurrent-realtime users | Realtime review |
| Commercial decision (D-16 flip) | Full T3 stack + license re-clearance |
